definition.name: lab_update_subpart
definition.description: Build or update high-density Blender architectural subparts (`total_faces >= 500,000` enforced via `finalize_and_save`) with closed-by-default curved roofs, outward-normal Boolean `arch_cut`, explicit `prism_xz/prism_yz/prism_xy`, `render_inspection_sheet`, `PartBMesh`, and 5 universal architectural subsystem modules.

definition.name: lab_bmesh_frame_and_clay
definition.description: Core BMesh collector, orientation-safe LocalFrame/EllipticalFrame, C_n/D_4 symmetry replicators, dihedral crease auto-smooth, 6-tone neutral clay & unit-X normalizer.

definition.name: lab_roofs_domes_and_shells
definition.description: Closed-by-default East Asian curved hip/xieshan/gable/pyramidal/cross roofs, polygonal pagoda/conical roofs, corbel brick eaves, ribbed/bulbous/onion domes & spherical sail shells.

definition.name: lab_columns_brackets_and_portals
definition.description: Entasis fluted classical columns, entablatures & pediments, 3D Chinese dougong rings/bays, Gothic splayed portals/rose windows & Persian pishtaq iwans.

definition.name: lab_walls_arcades_and_facades
definition.description: Analytical arch curves, mitered 2D profile rings, boolean-free perforated walls with deep jamb reveals, equal-arc-length curved arcades & curtain/louver facades.

definition.name: lab_towers_bridges_and_terraces
definition.description: Twisted ruled hyperboloid diagrids, exoskeletal suspension frames, occlusion-aware modular concrete clusters, stepped terraces/pyramids & humpback stone arch bridges.
